parameters.content:
## B2B Email Marketing Automation

**Required Feishu Fields (User fills):**
- Company Name
- Website
- Unread Emails

**Auto-filled Fields (Workflow fills):**
- Country
- Region (Asia, East-Aus, ME-Africa, Europe, North America, South America)
- Customer Profile
- Read Emails
- Last Open Time
- Follow-up Status (1/2/3/4)
- Last Follow-up Time

**Features:**
- Hourly Feishu sync
- Gemini AI analysis
- Region-based scheduling (8-9 AM local)
- Sequential company processing
- Sequential multi-email sending with 90-120s delay
- Email open tracking webhook
- Auto move Unread→Read Emails
- Immediate follow-up only after a new open event
- 3/7/15/30 day follow-up intervals

**Tracking pixel base URL:**
Set `TRACKING_BASE_URL` to your public webhook base URL, for example `https://your-n8n.example.com/webhook`

[Created by n8nbuilder.dev](https://n8nbuilder.dev)

={{ (() => { const evt = ($json.event || '').toString(); const fields = {}; if (evt) fields['送达状态'] = evt; if (evt === 'delivered') fields['送达时间'] = Date.parse($json.occurredAt) || Date.now(); if (evt === 'hard_bounced' || evt === 'soft_bounced' || evt.includes('bounce') || evt === 'blocked') fields['退信原因'] = ($json.reason || ''); if (evt === 'clicked') { fields['最后点击时间'] = Date.parse($json.occurredAt) || Date.now(); if ($json.url) fields['最后点击链接'] = $json.url; } if (evt === 'opened') { fields['最后打开时间'] = Date.parse($json.occurredAt) || Date.now(); } return JSON.stringify({ fields }); })() }}
